text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello. Do you know why the Winning 
Live was started in the first place?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's because the Umamusume who wins the 
race wants to express her gratitude to the 
fans who supported her, right?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I want them to see me in all 
my glory, so I can show my fans just how 
grateful I am for their support.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Though it seems the true beginning was a 
little different.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, an Umamusume said she wanted 
to sing, and that's how the Grand Live 
came to be.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "...You want to sing? Why is that?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's because it lets them 
connect.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...To connect.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And for that very reason, this song was 
performed at the very first Grand Live. 
Huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Writing lyrics for a song as requested by 
Light Hello. The Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...*pfft*.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Heat detected. Execute command: "Pour 
water over head"?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-That's totally fine! I just realized 
that writing lyrics really is hard work 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I understood it was the culmination of 
technique, but once I really think about 
it, there are just so many things to keep 
in mind...
choice_data_list: You don't need to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmm...
choice_data_list:
How about lining up the feelings you want 
to convey right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Our present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The feelings I want to convey...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to tell them, 'I'm home.' And 
say, 'Thank you for waiting for me.'"

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...I want them to watch me. Look at me! 
Follow me! I want to tell them to cheer 
for only me!"

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I want to tell them we're still on 
our journey! That no matter how much we 
lose, we have a finish line we refuse to 
give up on!

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell them that until then, no 
matter what happens, I want them to keep 
running alongside me...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell everyone... that I'm still 
running even now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To everyone hoping to see me sprint across 
that finish line: Thank you for letting me 
run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For me, it's the power to break through.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-chan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just how much of an impact do live 
concerts have on an Umamusume? 
Regrettably, that scope is still entirely 
unknown. All the more reason to pile on 
some extra expectations!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Then, in addition to saying "I'm 
home"...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Because you were there, I was able to run 
here... I think that's what I want to tell 
you."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite lively here. How are you 
feeling?
choice_data_list: Things seem to be going well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. Trainer, I actually have 
something to discuss regarding the setlist 
for the main showâ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then, I want lyrics made for 
call-and-response!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little different from just 
expressing our feelings, but I'd like it 
to be a song where we call out to each 
other...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Call and response... It is a format where 
we shout out cheers and chant back and 
forth.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, a fan mentioned that 
once. They said they love being able to 
cheer together at live shows.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right, right?! I mean...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and fans can't run together, but 
with singing, we can raise our voices as 
one!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe the best course of action would 
be to run that proposal by the others 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, let's go listen! There are new 
girls who just joined, too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume and their fans might not be 
able to run together, but when it comes to 
singing, they can raise their voices as 
one."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's why the Umamusume who first 
created the Grand Live chose song, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's to "connect" through 
singing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's put on the finishing touches as 
well! I hear more and more people are 
saying they'd love to participate again!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To make this the best live concert ever, 
please give it your all until the very 
end!
